archetypes.name: stale-line-refs
archetypes.rationale: The plan asserts ~15 specific line-number ranges across 10+ files; any stale reference causes the implementer to patch the wrong location or miss the target entirely.
archetypes.prompt_body: Cross-check every specific line-number claim in the plan against the actual current content of the named files (e.g., 'design_publish_stage_file near line 415', 'fallback relay ~lines 894-901', 'sanitize_diagnostic_line at lib-quiet.sh:86'). For each claimed line range, verify that the code structure described (loop body, guard placement, helper function name) actually exists at or near that range in the current file. Flag any claim where the described code is absent, significantly offset, or structurally different from the plan's description. Also verify that helpers the plan says to reuse (e.g. 'make_find_symlink_race_stub') are present in the referenced test harnesses at the stated location. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: relay-audit-gap
archetypes.rationale: The plan's Item B commits to a finite enumerated set of HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW sanitization sites; any uncovered relay leaves C0-byte injection paths open even after the fix lands.
archetypes.prompt_body: Grep the scope files for every larch_err and larch_errf call that passes a runtime variable (not a string literal), and cross-check each against the HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW sites the plan enumerates for the lib-quiet.md audit record. For any relay that forwards content from an external process, captured stderr, CI output, or vendor tool without a sanitize_diagnostic_line wrap, note it as a gap. Verify the plan's claim that 'printf '%s' "$line" | sanitize_diagnostic_line' is the correct per-line invocation against the sanitize_diagnostic_line contract in lib-quiet.sh (the plan cites lines 81-88): confirm the function accepts piped stdin and that per-line wrapping preserves blank-line behavior as asserted. Also check whether files the plan explicitly declares out of scope (larch-log.sh, step-7a.sh) contain relay patterns sharing the same external-content risk profile as the in-scope HIGH sites. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
